name: DOUTOR NICHIRES Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: DOUTOR NICHIRES Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates and manages coffee shops and restaurants in Japan. It manufactures and sells breads and western-style confectionery; roasts, processes, and sells coffee; and imports, exports, purchases, and sells food products, as well as recruits and guides restaurant franchisees through a franchise chain system.
